ns2:section.sectionText: Emphasizes the concepts of planning, organization, control, and decision making as they are applied in the management of the marketing function. Provides an overview of aspects of the marketing discipline. This course will be held in Vienna, Austria and Vicenza, Italy during Summer Session 1. May 15 through June 4. Acceptance by Professor Approval, Apply via the Study Abroad Website under "BADM 320 in Europe."
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore or Junior class standing.
